response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM acc) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM acc a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'The average across all accounts' means the mean of the per-account average transaction amounts, so each account counts equally. Accounts with no transactions are excluded.
trans.amount is used as stored (unsigned), so credits, withdrawals and VYBER rows are all averaged together without sign adjustment.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of all individual transactions, so accounts with more transactions weigh more.
